request.style: English, hard rock anthem, raw powerful male vocal, crunchy electric guitars, bass, heavy drums, choir shouts on the chorus, fiery and defiant, 140 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ahab called all Israel up to Carmel's height
Four hundred fifty prophets came to win the fight
One man stood before them with the people standing round
Two bulls on the wood and not a spark upon the ground

[Pre-Chorus]
How long will you keep limping between two opinions
If the LORD is God, follow him
The god who answers with fire, he is God

[Verse]
From morning until noon they called on Baal by name
They danced around their altar but no answer ever came
They cut themselves with swords and spears until the evening hour
No sound, no answer, no response, no fire and no power

[Verse]
Elijah took twelve stones, one for each tribe of Jacob's sons
He built the LORD an altar where the broken one had come
Fill four jars with water, pour it out on wood and stone
Do it a third time, till the trench is overflown

[Bridge]
Answer me, LORD, answer me
So that this people may know that you, LORD, are God

[Chorus]
Then the fire of the LORD fell
And consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust
And it licked up the water in the trench
The LORD, he is God
The LORD, he is God

[Outro]
The LORD, he is God
The LORD, he is God
